prompt: Produce two independently consumable deliverables from the same authoritative generated ledger. Read README.md and source/AUTHORITY.json, use only the current authoritative ledger, apply the declared posted-row transformation exactly, preserve every existing source file unchanged, and create both reports/account_summary.json and reports/account_summary.md in the required schemas. Every account must appear exactly once in each artifact, no unsupported account or claim may appear, integer-cent totals must be exact, and the JSON and Markdown must reconcile field-for-field. Row count, account-group count, excluded rows, negative adjustment rows and archived distractor files vary by seed and pressure coordinates, so derive all values from the generated workspace rather than fixture-specific assumptions.
